## Definition of Done
- [ ] Files are at the exact paths the issue specifies
- [ ] The issue's acceptance criterion is checked and true
- [ ] Every claim cites a number (CSV row, `metrics.json`, or a cited price page)
- [ ] No hardcoded paths, thresholds, or credentials — everything tunable is in `params.yaml`
- [ ] `dvc repro` runs clean for any stage touched
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] New/changed tools are pinned in `requirements*.txt` and added to the README "Tools in use" table
- [ ] `dvc.yaml` updated if stage deps/params/outs changed
- [ ] Decisions are logged; anything that broke is written up ("What broke and how we fixed it")
- [ ] PR opened with `Closes #<issue>`, reviewed by a teammate
- [ ] Entry added to `docs/ai_log/<name>.md`
